frozen_by: Core Evaluation lane, factory direction v56, run 39113690481 (repair round 1 of rejected cycle 39111232991)
question: Which of the two claims made about cycle 39111232991 survive its own inputs? (a) Is the product-layer parity-regression claim admissible at all on the frozen analyst mapping, when the mapping is measured mechanically against the product's own served-question records? (b) Independent of any analyst mapping: does a served bundle retrieve the core legal concepts of the question it claims to answer, and is any admission gap hiding that?

why_this_is_the_smallest_repair.D1: the freeze labelled corporate-criminal-liability<->de-kapitalverletzung and rent-default<->fr-bail-entretien 'same subject'. The product's own question.json says the first is the employment-law duty of care under OR 321 ff. (not Art. 102 StGB) and the second is defaut d'entretien (not rent arrears). A subject-mismatched cell can show product<baseline with no product defect at all.
why_this_is_the_smallest_repair.D2: the comparator scored by v1 is the frozen record's baseline U counter channel (3x50 + 3x30 = 240 rows), not 'the plain OpenCaseLaw top-50'. The record carries an explicit per-query 'channel' field, so the split is measurable, not rhetorical.
why_this_is_the_smallest_repair.D4: the successor deliverable is either a frozen spec re-derived against the questions the product actually serves, or the frozen questions actually served. Neither is possible inside the accepted served packet, which serves no frozen slug. What IS possible without any new network fetch, new corpus or new freeze of the accepted spec is to measure the product on the questions it serves, by its own text.
why_this_is_the_smallest_repair.why_v1_is_not_edited: v1 stays byte-unchanged as the record of the first freeze and of the verdict it produced. This file is a NEW frozen spec with a NEW digest, which is exactly what the v1 hypothesis itself mandates ('If any gate predicate here has to change after the first execution, that is a NEW frozen spec with a NEW digest, and the old record is preserved') and exactly what audit fix D1 requires.
why_this_is_the_smallest_repair.size: One instrument (evaluation/subject_match_audit.py), one frozen file, two sha256-pinned derivatives, one test file. No new benchmark family, no network, no classifier build, no layout build, no new threshold in any frozen verdict file.

analyst_mapping_V2_FROZEN_BEFORE_EXECUTI.disclosure: This is a NEW frozen mapping, not an edit of the v1 one. v1's declared bases are retracted (see correction CYCLE_39111232991_CORRECTION.md). The three served_question_ids are UNCHANGED - only the admissibility declaration and its stated reason change. Each cell declares whether it may support a PRODUCT-LAYER claim, and the measurement is permitted to DOWNGRADE a declaration but never to upgrade it.

cells.product_layer_claim_inadmissible_reason: PARTIAL subject match, same article family but a different factual predicate. The product's own question.json legal_area is 'droit du bail - entretien de l'immeuble et resiliation (CP 257d ss.)' and its question is 'Resiliation du bail pour defaut d'entretien du bailleur', i.e. the landlord's failure to maintain. The frozen slug's baseline queries ask under which conditions a landlord may terminate for LATE PAYMENT OF RENT. Same norm family (257d), different predicate. A product<baseline result on this cell is therefore not established as a product-layer defect.

MISMATCHED SUBJECT. The product's own question.json legal_area is 'Arbeitsrecht - Sorgfaltspflichten des Arbeitgebers bei Kapitalverletzung (OR 321 ff., EOG)': an EMPLOYMENT-LAW duty of care. The frozen slug is criminal liability of the company under Art. 102 StGB. The shared word 'Kapitalverletzung' is used in two different senses under two different norms, which is exactly the confusion the v1 basis text made. No norm token is shared.
MISMATCHED SUBJECT, disclosed as weak by v1 and kept weak here. Medical liability under c.c. 2052 ss. is not dismissal of a petty thief under art. 337 StGB. No norm token is shared.

analyst_mapping_V2_FROZEN_BEFORE_EXECUTI.unmapped_frozen_slug: business-judgment-rule has no served counterpart in the accepted packet and stays NOT_MEASURED, exactly as in v1.

admissibility_rule_FROZEN.statement: A mapping cell supports a PRODUCT-LAYER claim if and only if BOTH hold: (1) the cell declares product_layer_claim_admissible=true in this file, and (2) the measurement returns norm_axis == SAME_NORM AND subject_axis == SAME_SUBJECT_TERMS. The measurement can only downgrade a declaration. A false declaration with a SAME_NORM/ SAME_SUBJECT_TERMS measurement is NOT an error: it is the conservative direction and is recorded, never corrected upward by the measurement.
admissibility_rule_FROZEN.norm_axis: SAME_NORM iff the frozen slug's norm_tokens (declared, unioned with lexically harvested article references in its own frozen query texts) intersect the norm references lexically harvested from the product's own question.json subject fields (legal_area, question, hypothesis, look_for, counter_authority_needed, why_this_question). DIFFERENT_NORM iff both sides name at least one norm and the intersection is empty. UNANCHORED_ON_ONE_SIDE otherwise.
admissibility_rule_FROZEN.subject_axis: SAME_SUBJECT_TERMS iff at least one content token is shared, content tokens being de-accented lowercase alnum tokens of length >= 5 with the frozen generic stoplist removed.
admissibility_rule_FROZEN.generic_stoplist_frozen: defined once in evaluation/subject_match_audit.py GENERIC_STOPWORDS and re-published in the extract's method field; it contains only generic legal/procedural function words and is not tuned to any cell
admissibility_rule_FROZEN.no_constant: no threshold, no weight, no tunable constant. The only decisions are set membership and set intersection.

comparator_rule_FROZEN.statement: The comparator scored by v1 is reported as the union of the frozen baseline record's own per-query channels, split by that record's explicit 'channel' field. For every cell the record publishes baseline-channel-only hits, counter-channel-only hits, and the set of comparator hits reachable ONLY through the counter channel, so the phrase 'the plain OpenCaseLaw top-50 it wraps' is either supported by numbers or withdrawn.
comparator_rule_FROZEN.counter_channel_caveat: The counter channel's queries are limitation-token queries ('Art. 257d al. 2 CO resiliation abusive exception limite ...'); they are themselves a counter-authority search design, not a plain natural-language query. Any baseline advantage carried by that channel is NOT a plain-search advantage.

question_native_rule_FROZEN.why: This is the falsifier that needs no analyst mapping at all and therefore cannot inherit D1. It asks only: for the question the product actually serves, do the product's own rows retrieve the core legal concepts of that question, and does the packet's own admission record disclose it when they do not?
question_native_rule_FROZEN.concept_extraction: core concepts = de-accented lowercase alnum tokens of the served question's own 'question' text with length >= 5 and the frozen generic stoplist removed; nothing is added, dropped or weighted beyond that, and question words that survive (e.g. Italian 'quale', 'devono', 'essere') are KEPT, which can only make the coverage gate easier to pass, never harder
question_native_rule_FROZEN.coverage_measure: a concept is COVERED iff at least one bundle row's concatenated (title, regeste, snippet, full_text, citation, decision_id) contains it as a substring. Substring containment is deliberately permissive: it can only over-report coverage, so a COVERAGE_DEFECT verdict cannot be an artefact of strict tokenisation. This is the same >=1-of-set semantics the accepted retrieval gates use.
gates: question_native_concept_coverage::<qid> - every core concept of the served question is covered by at least one bundle row

admission::selfcheck_disagreement::<qid> - NOT a defect only if the packet did not admit the bundle cleanly while its own concept self-check reports zero-row concepts. This gate fires when admissibility.admissible is true AND warning_count == 0 AND blocking_count == 0 AND at least one core concept has zero rows.
question_native_rule_FROZEN.selfcheck_cross_check: the packet's own measured query_concept_rows / query_concepts_under_covered are published side by side with the independent recomputation, and gate provenance::v1_and_extract_identity publishes both extract digests. Agreement and disagreement are both reported; neither is suppressed.

decision_rule_V2_FROZEN.statement: This cycle's verdict is decided by the question-native, mapping-free gates and by the non-vacuity battery, NOT by the recall numbers v1 produced. ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS (exit 2) if any non-vacuity control fails. Otherwise: if any question_native_concept_coverage:: or admission::selfcheck_disagreement:: gate fails, the verdict is QUESTION_NATIVE_PRODUCT_DEFECT_ESTABLISHED (or QUESTION_NATIVE_PRODUCT_DEFECT_AND_HARNESS_FALSIFICATION_STAND when at least one cell is simultaneously admissible) at exit 1; if no mapping-free gate fails, the verdict is HARNESS_FALSIFICATION_STANDS_NO_ADMISSIBLE_PRODUCT_CLAIM or NO_MAPPING_FREE_PRODUCT_DEFECT_FOUND, exit 0 only for the latter.
decision_rule_V2_FROZEN.what_this_verdict_does_not_do: It does not re-score, weaken or replace the v1 harness result, which is read and preserved. It does not change any frozen bar, rubric, threshold, spec or accepted verdict. It does not decide whether the product is useful.

non_vacuity_FROZEN.requirement: three hostile controls must fire before any verdict is reportable: (a) a deliberately BLANKED bundle must cover zero core concepts; (b) a payload-equivalence oracle containing every core concept text must reach full coverage, proving the gate can go green; (c) the subject-match admissibility gate must demonstrably discriminate, i.e. at least one cell must measure norm_axis == DIFFERENT_NORM. If any control fails the verdict is ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS (exit 2) and is discarded, never reported as a pass.
non_vacuity_FROZEN.rationale: Same non-vacuity discipline as evaluation.benchmark_retrieval_counter_authority, evaluation.packet_lineage_sweep and v1 of this benchmark. A gate that cannot fail is not a measurement.

pre_execution_disclosure_HONEST.what_was_seen_before_this_file_was_writt: The audit report CYCLE_39111232991.md and the accepted product mount were read before this freeze, in this order: (1) the audit's D1-D4 findings and its channel-split recompute; (2) the three served question.json records, whose legal_area / question texts establish the subject mismatch; (3) the packet's OWN admission measurement for each question, including de-kapitalverletzung's query_concepts_under_covered = ['kapitalverletzung', 'uberwachungspflicht'] with query_concept_rows 0 for both, and its admissibility block admissible=true, blocking_count=0, warning_count=0; (4) one execution of `python -m evaluation.subject_match_audit --build-vendored`, which writes the two pinned derivatives, after which their concept_row_counts were printed and the two zero-row concepts for de-kapitalverletzung were visible.
pre_execution_disclosure_HONEST.what_was_NOT_seen_before_this_file_writt: The instrument had never been executed as a scorer. No subject_match_audit record existed. No subject axis, no channel split, no gate result and no verdict had been computed.
pre_execution_disclosure_HONEST.why_it_does_not_launder_the_result: The two items an observer might suspect of being fitted - the concept-coverage rule and the admissibility rule - were fixed by architecture, not by the numbers. Concept coverage is the >=1-of-set semantics the accepted retrieval gates already use, applied to the served question's own words. Admissibility is set intersection over norm tokens and content tokens with the measurement permitted only to DOWNGRADE a declaration that was already false in all three cells. Both were written down before execution, and the disclosure above names the product's own under-coverage figure rather than hiding it. What the disclosure DOES buy the reader is the ability to reject the concept-extraction method (substring containment, length>=5, stoplist) on its face; that choice is disclosed here precisely because it is visible in the result.
pre_execution_disclosure_HONEST.accepted_precedent: evaluation/reality_gate and evaluation/retrieval_gate carry equivalent honest_pre_freeze_disclosure fields; v1 of this benchmark carries pre_execution_disclosure_HONEST with the same structure.

claim_ceiling: This cycle can establish exactly two things. (1) The cycle-39111232991 harness result stands as a HARNESS result and does NOT establish a product-layer recall defect on any of its three cells, because no cell is subject-matched to the question the product serves; the correct successor is a frozen spec re-derived against served questions, or serving the frozen questions, and neither is possible inside the accepted served packet. (2) Independent of any mapping, a served bundle either does or does not retrieve the core legal concepts of its own question, and the packet's admission record either does or does not disclose that. It does NOT prove the map is useful or useless to a jurist; it does NOT re-classify any decision as supporting/contrary/limiting; it does NOT re-score or move the label or geometry bars (LABEL_UNSOUND 5/65, GEOMETRY_UNSOUND 0/3 bundles at 11/11 unchanged); it does NOT lift the accepted DO-NOT-SERVE order on packet 38839347028 nor DO-NOT-SERVE-UNCHANGED on rebuilt-39027045675; it does NOT certify admission of any packet; human_gate_ready stays false. A concept that is a German compound noun may simply not be the doctrine's own vocabulary, so a zero-row concept is a retrieval signal the product itself already computes, not proof that the authorities are absent - that caveat is frozen in the report and is not to be dropped after results are seen.
